parrafo.es: Clique Salon & Med Spa es un salón y med spa en Lakeland, FL, dentro de la plaza del restaurante Outback. Rosa trabaja con cabello grueso, rizado, largo y ondulado que a otros estilistas les cuesta manejar, Brandi y Kate completan el equipo, y también hay tratamientos de botox e inyectables.
parrafo.en: Clique Salon & Med Spa is a hair studio and med spa in Lakeland, FL, inside the Outback Restaurant Plaza. Rosa works with thick, curly, long and wavy hair other stylists struggle with, Brandi and Kate round out the styling team, and botox and injectable treatments are available too.

parrafo_1.es: Clique Salon & Med Spa es un salón y med spa en Lakeland, dentro de la plaza del restaurante Outback. Rosa se ha ganado seguidoras por su trabajo con cabello grueso, rizado, largo y ondulado, las texturas más difíciles de acertar, y Brandi y Kate completan el equipo de estilismo para color y looks del día a día.
parrafo_1.en: Clique Salon & Med Spa is a hair studio and med spa in Lakeland, inside the Outback Restaurant Plaza. Rosa has built a following for her work with thick, curly, long and wavy hair, the textures that are hardest to get right, and Brandi and Kate round out the styling team for color and everyday looks.

parrafo_2.es: El lado de med spa incluye botox e inyectables, y las reseñas mencionan los relajantes lavados de cabello tanto como el resultado final de color. Las reseñas de Google muestran clientas que vuelven con la misma estilista, año tras año.
parrafo_2.en: The med spa side includes botox and injectable treatments, and reviewers mention the relaxing hair washes as often as the finished color. Google reviewers keep coming back to the same stylist by name, year after year.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué buscas: corte, color, blower o una consulta de botox, y te damos un espacio en la agenda.
texto.en: Tell us what you want, a haircut, color, a blowout or a botox consult, and we will get you on the schedule.

texto.es: Rosa, Brandi o Kate revisan tu tipo de cabello y lo que buscas, o Jimmy revisa tu consulta de botox, antes de empezar.
texto.en: Rosa, Brandi or Kate look at your hair type and goal, or Jimmy reviews your botox concern, before anything starts.

texto.es: Cada corte, color o tratamiento se hace a mano, con el cuidado y los lavados relajantes de los que hablan nuestras reseñas.
texto.en: Every cut, color or treatment is done by hand, with the care and the relaxing washes our reviews talk about.

texto.es: Sales peinada y lista, con el look que pediste y consejos para mantenerlo en casa.
texto.en: You leave styled and ready, with the look you asked for and tips to keep it that way at home.

nota.es: El precio depende del largo, la textura y el servicio que elijas. Llámanos y te explicamos todo antes de reservar.
nota.en: Prices depend on hair length, texture and the service you choose. Call us and we will walk you through it before you book.

subtitulo.es: Reseñas reales de clientes en Google.

items.quote: I can’t say enough amazing things about Rosa! As a Dominican woman with thick, curly hair, it has always been a challenge for me to find someone who truly knows how to cut and blow dry my hair the right way. I’ve been coming to her for over 3 years now, and she is hands down the BEST!

Rosa is the hair whisperer. She fixed my hair strands and made my hair look so healthy! I recommend her and I am sure the other ladies are amazing as well. So happy to found someone that can finally work with me thick, wavy hair.

My daughter and I received services here and we are extremely happy with the service we received. Brandi and Kate was amazing at turning our hair into exactly what we had envisioned. I received my first botox session, targeting my tmj, and Jimmy was amazing!
